units.source_text: 遥拜式结束后，我忽然不安起来。

en.t: After the ceremony of distant worship ended, I suddenly grew uneasy.

units.source_text: 记得镇上家家户户点燃的追悼灯笼格外明亮，可见当晚一定是黑黢黢的。

en.t: I remember that the mourning lanterns lit at every house in town were especially bright, which shows how pitch dark that night must have been.

units.source_text: 我脱下木屐，打着赤脚，一口气跑了一里半路回到家里。

en.t: I took off my wooden clogs and, barefoot, ran the mile and a half home in one breath.

units.source_text: 祖父活到了当天子夜过后。

en.t: My grandfather lived until after midnight that day.
